name: verby
description: Verby — Character.AI-style chats with unified design, streaming AI, cloud sync, native shell

scripts.build: echo 'Static SPA — copy to dist for Capacitor' && mkdir -p dist && cp -r index.html app.js app-core.js app-ui.js app-actions.js app-chat.js sw.js manifest.json api dist/ 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.cap:init: npx cap add android && npx cap add ios
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
